001.purpose: Vinyan ESP32 learning board with a CH32 USB/interface controller, discrete LED-matrix drivers, buttons, buzzer and sensor expansion.
001.power: USB-C or DC barrel input. Confirm the limit printed on your board: this revision's documented DC input limits are under review. Accessory ports and GPIO use 3.3 V only.
connectors: J1 I2C chain, JST XH 4-pin: 1=3V3, 2=GND, 3=SDA, 4=SCL; ESP32 IO4/IO5.
JST XH 3-pin accessories: 1=3V3, 2=signal, 3=GND. IN1–IN4 use IO32/33/34/35; OUT1/OUT2 use IO26/27.
J11/J14 carry the external LED matrix. J15 exposes ESP32 signals; J12 is the sensor socket.
notes: IO34/IO35 are input-only and have no internal pull-up.
The LDR and NTC share GPIO39/GPIO36 with J12 through jumpers J17/J18. Remove the appropriate jumper before connecting another sensor on that pin.
IO12 on J12 is an ESP32 boot strap: holding it high at reset can prevent boot.
This page identifies PCB V 1.0. Existing electrical, thermal and revision review items remain; a QR label does not establish fabrication approval.

002.purpose: Arivaan RP2354B GPIO and logic-analyzer expansion board for the Vinyan ecosystem.
002.power: USB-C powered with a regulated 3.3 V logic rail. GPIO signals are 3.3 V only. PWRA has no onboard supply; its voltage and current limits require review before external power is connected.
connectors: J1032 is the USB-C input.
J1006–J1009 are 1×08 GPIO/display breakout headers. J1016 is a 2×20 socket; J1004/J1005 and J1030/J1031 are 1×16 headers/sockets.
J1003 is JST SH 4-pin; J1015 is JST XH 4-pin; J1017–J1019/J1027–J1029 are JST XH 3-pin. Check each connector's printed labels; PWRA is not automatically 3.3 V.
S1001/S1002 are tactile buttons; debug access includes SWD/SWCLK.
notes: GPIO0 and GPIO1 are connected together on this revision. Do not use default UART0 pins; configure at most one as an output.
The input protection and regulator load/thermal budget require qualification. This development revision is not a fabrication approval.

003.purpose: Vaghan RP2354B expansion board with DC motor channels, servo outputs, analog inputs and power conditioning.
003.power: USB-C PD or barrel input with 3.3 V, 5 V and motor rails. Follow connector labels and revision-specific load limits. Motor/servo loads and startup safety are unqualified on PCB 0.1; do not treat its connector count as an approved current budget.
connectors: J2 is USB-C; J3/J4 are barrel inputs.
Motor channels use two dual H-bridge drivers. Servo outputs use J20–J27 JST XH connectors and J28–J33 headers on the 5 V servo rail.
Analog inputs expose GPIO40–GPIO47 (ADC0–ADC7). USB, I2C, UART and SWD debug connections are available.
notes: The current RP2354B revision is not fabrication-ready. It has outstanding power-path, servo-rail, gate-voltage and motor-startup review items.
A future controller redesign is separate hardware and will receive a new permanent ID.

004.purpose: BH1750 ambient-light sensor for the Vinyan I2C chain.
004.power: 3.3 V only. Do not connect to 5 V.
connectors: Vinyan J1 / JST XH 4-pin: 1=3V3, 2=GND, 3=SDA, 4=SCL. Parallel chain-out uses the same order.
notes: I2C address is 0x23 by default; the address jumper can select 0x5C.
Optional I2C pull-ups and power LED jumpers are open by default. Vinyan supplies I2C pull-ups.
The BH1750 land pattern requires datasheet verification before fabrication.

005.purpose: BMP280 barometric pressure and temperature sensor for the Vinyan I2C chain.
005.power: 3.3 V only. Do not connect to 5 V.
connectors: Vinyan J1 / JST XH 4-pin: 1=3V3, 2=GND, 3=SDA, 4=SCL. Parallel chain-out uses the same order.
notes: I2C address is 0x77 by default; the address jumper can select 0x76.
Keep the sensor vent clear of coating and silkscreen.
Optional I2C pull-ups and power LED jumpers are open by default.

006.purpose: DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor with a single-wire data connection.
connectors: Vinyan OUT1/OUT2 / JST XH 3-pin: 1=3V3, 2=DATA, 3=GND. OUT1/OUT2 use IO26/IO27.
notes: The board provides a 10 kΩ data pull-up.
Use OUT1/OUT2; IN3/IN4 are input-only and cannot drive the sensor's request pulse.

007.purpose: Single 10 mm LED indicator driven from a Vinyan output.
007.power: 3.3 V accessory port only. The current circuit is intended for a red LED with its fitted series resistor.
connectors: Vinyan OUT1/OUT2 / JST XH 3-pin: 1=3V3, 2=LED, 3=GND.
notes: The LED is driven directly through a series resistor. LED colour and resistor substitutions require checking GPIO current and forward voltage.

008.purpose: Carrier for a 0.96-inch SSD1306 I2C OLED display.
008.power: 3.3 V accessory port only. Verify the display module's supply pins before insertion.
connectors: Vinyan J1 / JST XH 4-pin: 1=3V3, 2=GND, 3=SDA, 4=SCL; parallel chain-out.
Display socket order: GND, VCC, SCL, SDA. Some modules swap GND/VCC; check your module.
notes: Typical I2C address is 0x3C; some modules use 0x3D.
The display module can overhang the carrier. Use appropriate mounting standoffs.
Optional I2C pull-ups are open by default.

009.purpose: Rotary potentiometer providing an analog input to Vinyan.
009.power: 3.3 V only; wiper output spans approximately 0–3.3 V.
connectors: Vinyan IN1–IN4 / JST XH 3-pin: 1=3V3, 2=POT, 3=GND.
notes: The circuit uses a 10 kΩ potentiometer with filtering on the wiper.
ESP32 ADC response is nonlinear near the upper end of the input range.

010.purpose: 12×12 mm momentary push button with active-low output and RC debounce.
connectors: Vinyan IN1–IN4 / JST XH 3-pin: 1=3V3, 2=BTN, 3=GND.
notes: Pressed reads low. The board provides a 10 kΩ pull-up and 100 nF debounce capacitor.
The onboard pull-up permits use on IN3/IN4, which have no internal pull-up.

011.purpose: Analog carrier for a resistive soil-moisture fork.
011.power: 3.3 V accessory port only; analog output stays within the supply range.
connectors: Vinyan IN1–IN4 / JST XH 3-pin: 1=3V3, 2=SOIL, 3=GND.
The separate two-pin terminal connects the resistive probe.
notes: The probe forms a divider with a 10 kΩ resistor to ground. Wetter soil normally produces a higher reading.
Resistive probes corrode under continuous DC excitation; inspect the probe periodically.

012.purpose: CH224K USB-C Power Delivery sink supplying a separate DC power input.
012.power: USB-C PD input; raw VBUS output, normally configured for 12 V or optionally 9 V. Never connect this output to a 3.3 V JST accessory port. Confirm your host board's DC limit before choosing a profile.
connectors: USB-C receptacle is the input.
Two-pin output terminal: +=VBUS, −=GND. This connects to an approved host DC/barrel input, not its accessory ports.
notes: The configured jumper selects 12 V by default or 9 V. The charger must support the requested profile; a non-PD source supplies 5 V.
Vinyan's currently documented DC limits are under review. Do not assume every Vinyan revision accepts the default 12 V profile.
This design is intended for 9/12 V profiles, not 15/20 V.

013.power: 3.3 V accessory port only. Use a 3.3 V compatible RCWL-1601 or HC-SR04P; a standard 5 V HC-SR04 is unsuitable.
connectors: Vinyan OUT1/OUT2 / JST XH 3-pin: 1=3V3, 2=SONAR, 3=GND.
Module socket order: VCC, TRIG, ECHO, GND.
notes: TRIG is driven from SONAR; ECHO connects through 1 kΩ to limit contention.
Firmware sends a trigger pulse, switches the pin to input and measures the echo pulse. Use a bidirectional OUT port.

014.purpose: Three WS2812B-2020 addressable RGB LEDs with a data chain-out.
014.power: Vinyan supplies 3.3 V. This is below the WS2812B-2020 documented 3.7 V minimum and remains a hardware qualification limitation.
connectors: Input / Vinyan OUT1/OUT2 / JST XH 3-pin: 1=3V3, 2=DIN, 3=GND.
Chain-out / JST XH 3-pin: 1=3V3, 2=DOUT, 3=GND.
notes: Addressable LEDs receive a single-wire data stream; DOUT chains to another board.
Operation at 3.3 V is not guaranteed by the quoted device supply specification. Verify brightness, colour and reliable startup on actual hardware.

015.purpose: Passive 16×8 matrix with 128 discrete 0402 LEDs for Vinyan's external matrix drivers.
015.power: No onboard driver or standalone supply input. Connect only to the compatible host matrix driver with verified orientation.
connectors: Matrix A carries ROW0–ROW7 and COL0–COL7 to Vinyan J11/J14 pins 9–16.
Matrix B carries ROW8–ROW15 and COL0–COL7 to Vinyan J11/J14 pins 1–8. Match the printed row/column labels before connecting.
notes: This current source has no PCB title-block revision. Its permanent ID identifies the recorded unversioned source, not every future 0402 matrix.
The two 8×8 sections have separate row lines; column lines join at the host.

016.purpose: Passive 16×8 matrix with 128 discrete 0805 LEDs for Arivaan's large-display headers.
016.power: No onboard driver or standalone supply input. Verify host driver compatibility and header orientation before connecting.
connectors: Matrix A: J1008 pins 1–8 carry B1–B8; J1006 pins 9–16 carry C1–C8.
Matrix B: J1009 pins 1–8 carry B9–B16; J1007 pins 9–16 carry C9–C16.
notes: The matrix is passive; LED drive and current limiting belong to the host.
Header rows are 24.0 mm apart and the two module centres are 32.265 mm apart.

017.power: No onboard driver or standalone supply input. Row/column drive and current limiting belong to the compatible host.
connectors: J1/J2 are eight-pin row/column headers. Verify their printed pin labels against the host before connecting.
notes: This current source has no PCB title-block revision. Its permanent ID identifies the recorded unversioned source.
This is the 8×8 base design used by the 16×8 0402 panel.

018.power: No onboard driver or standalone supply input. Row/column drive and current limiting belong to the compatible host.
connectors: J1/J2 are eight-pin row/column headers. Verify their printed pin labels against the host before connecting.
notes: This is the 0805 base design used by the 16×8 0805 panel. This page identifies PCB revision 1.0.
